snippet.title: ALPINE ZONE - PlayStation 4 Gameplay
snippet.description:
Along the way there will be obstacles, crashing into which you will jump from them. The faster the speed, and the speed increases over time, the more you will bounce. Along the way you will literally have to pick up your score. The score will also be added depending on the distance traveled. You will lose if you go beyond the boundaries of the playing field.

Developed by Xitilon

#ps4 #playstation4 #xitilon #alpinezone #theforeseenarcade
